claims: NASA is targeting April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 GMT) for the launch of Artemis II.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II will orbit the Moon and return to Earth.
Artemis II will test critical systems for deep space exploration.
The launch of Artemis II is from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Reid Wiseman (NASA), Victor Glover (NASA), Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
Artemis II was previously delayed from February and March 2026 due to technical issues.
Artemis II remains on track for the new April 2026 target.
